recent_facts: The IKEA Effect explains why we irrationally overvalue our own work, a bias that can be neutralized by asking if we would choose our current projects if we hadn't started them ourselves.
The Chainstore Paradox reveals that irrational aggression can be a rational long-term strategy to deter future competitors.
